title: Exact-window capture with bounded capture leases
objective: Implement Windows-first exact-window pixel capture behind Quntal's existing desktop identity model. Capture must bind the exact process instance, HWND/window generation, session, dimensions/DPI, policy revision, and protected-surface rules. Repeated observation uses a local-only, revocable, time-bounded CaptureLease that cannot be minted by a model or remote caller.

include: native exact-window capture using a Windows API suitable for per-window capture rather than whole-screen grab
capture identity bound to process PID+creation time, HWND, class, window generation, session, geometry/DPI, policy revision, and capture generation
server-issued CaptureLease with exact window scope, maximum duration/rate/frame byte dimensions, local issuance, explicit revoke, and deterministic expiry

lease invalidation on process/window replacement, geometry/session changes where required by contract, lock/logoff, policy/workspace/trust revision change, emergency revoke, secure-desktop transition, or Quntal restart

exclusion of Quntal-owned windows, Quntal approval/trust/revoke UI, CredentialUIBroker, consent/UAC, LogonUI, secure desktop, foreign sessions, stale/reused handles, protected markers, and explicitly denied windows
bounded image dimensions/bytes/rate and secret-safe metadata logging with no screenshot bytes in logs/metrics
tests on real Windows for DPI scaling, resize/move, minimized/occluded behavior, multi-monitor placement, stale HWND/PID reuse, RDP/session transition, lock/logoff, and protected surfaces

authority_delta.filesystem: No general filesystem authority; transient image buffers/files if required remain under protected Quntal state and bounded cleanup policy.
authority_delta.secrets: Window pixels become observable only for exact locally authorized non-protected windows under bounded capture authority; protected/security surfaces are excluded by construction.
authority_delta.approval: CaptureLease issuance is a local authority decision at the required presence/approval class and cannot be delegated to the model/remote caller.
authority_delta.privileged: None; no secure-desktop capture or elevation.

invariants: capture is exact-window scoped and never silently widens to the screen/session
capture leases are local-only, bounded, revocable, and stale on identity/session/policy drift

acceptance.claim: A real Windows window can be captured with exact process/window/generation/DPI binding and deterministic bounded output.
Quntal, credential, UAC/consent, LogonUI, secure-desktop, foreign-session, stale/reused-handle, and protected-marker targets fail closed before pixels are returned.
CaptureLease issuance/reuse/revoke/expiry and lock/logoff/session/window/process/policy invalidation are deterministic, and no model/MCP/remote path can mint or widen a lease.
Real-machine tests cover DPI, resize/move, multi-monitor, RDP/session, lock/logoff, minimized/occluded behavior, and stale identity without whole-screen fallback.
Exact-head Windows CI, TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, security review, privacy/log review, and zero unresolved blockers pass.

successor_requirements.sg_000081: Structured UIA actuation may activate only after desktop observation/capture identities and protected-surface rules are canonically qualified.

done_when: Exact-window capture and local bounded capture leases are canonically qualified with protected-surface exclusion, stale invalidation, privacy bounds, and no screen-wide or remote widening.
